description: Promptfoo 0.125 runs one eval: one prompt, a contains assertion and an llm-rubric assertion graded by a second model call, traced by Promptfoo's own OTLP export.
notes: promptfoo eval runs from a temporary directory with its config directory in it. The provider and the llm-rubric grader both call the mock's /v1 (apiBaseUrl), with the same provider id, so the grader is a second chat call. The grader's turn returns the JSON that promptfoo's llm-rubric parser reads: {"pass": true, "score": 1, "reason": ...} (promptfoo's runJsonGradingPrompt and deriveVerdictFromGrader). Promptfoo exports its spans to the receiver through PROMPTFOO_OTEL_ENABLED and PROMPTFOO_OTEL_ENDPOINT (the full traces URL, passed to the exporter as given). Its network use is off through PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY, PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE and PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING, each checked in promptfoo 0.125.1's dist. --max-concurrency 1 keeps the span order stable. Expected spans: the test case (evaluator), the provider wrapper (span), the target chat call (llm), the grader's evaluator and its chat call (llm).
